gaps_and_rejections.finding: Searching Ash Wednesday context still yields action images, plastic take-home containers, or historical illustration, not a clear isolated traditional ash vessel.
Most French heritage photographs show assembled altar-gradine-tabernacle complex rather than independent gradine; reproduction permissions not resolved.
Catholic sanctuary lamps are mostly seen hanging in contextual sanctuary photographs; isolated representative red glass lamp with explicit reuse rights still missing.
LACMA M.2019.264.3 photo-licence conflict persists despite independently CC0-licensed Japanese Missal stand being newly identified.
Photo searches commonly surface Anglican pew kneelers; must not substitute a Protestant/Anglican object for this Catholic atlas.
Secular tabletop Victorian candle snuffers are not long-handled Catholic altar candle extinguishers.
Epistle/Gospel sides are direction annotations on authenticated altar photograph rather than collectible objects.

uniqueness_rules.novelty_note: Records target 10 distinct object IDs not represented as unique B21 acquisition subjects. SA04 entry is explicit historical comparison only to prevent duplication.
